confidence_notes: Holistic estimate from general knowledge of Croatian Adriatic coastal pricing for July peak season; no live booking pages, menus, or current listings were inspected. Restaurant and beer anchors are more reliable than accommodation, which varies widely with dates, season, and location within Zadar. Cocktail and wine anchors are set from the local price relationship to beer, since direct knowledge of those prices is weaker. Euro-denominated prices were converted to USD at an assumed rate of roughly 1.15 USD per EUR.
comparable_city_reasoning: Based on general knowledge of Croatian coastal tourism pricing, using Split and the wider Dalmatian coast as the reference, with Zadar priced somewhat below Split and Dubrovnik. Accommodation anchors assume July peak-season rates, including taxes and mandatory fees.
